transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Well, what brings me in is that I just can't keep my mind on one thing anymore. I work at a warehouse, and lately... it's like every little thing pulls me off my count. A beeper goes off, or a forklift alarm sounds, or even just someone moving a pallet nearby, and my attention is completely gone. Then I look down and realize I've put the wrong numbers into the inventory. It's getting really frustrating to deal with.
Did you have trouble paying attention like this when you were a child?

No, not really. I mean, I did fine in school, as far as I can remember. I wasn't the kind of kid who couldn't sit still or focus on homework. This... this feels different. It's just been happening lately at the warehouse, not something I've dealt with my whole life.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

No, I wouldn't say I've been feeling depressed. I mean, I get frustrated with myself at work because of the mistakes I'm making, but I don't feel down or sad or anything like that. It's just the distraction that's really bothering me.
Have you been worrying a lot lately?

No, not really. I mean, I'm not a worrier. I'm just annoyed about messing up my inventory counts. But I'm not sitting at home stressing about things or anything like that. It's just the focusing part that's the problem.
Have you had a period lately where you felt unusually energetic or high?

Well, actually, yes. There are some days lately where I feel almost too upbeat. It's like I have so much energy I could fix up the whole house and sort out the whole warehouse all before dinner. But then... if my husband questions one of my plans or something, I just snap at him over something completely small.
When you feel that unusually high energy, do you need less sleep than usual?

No, not really. I mean... I haven't noticed any changes there. Even when I have all that extra energy during the day, I still feel like I need my regular amount of rest at night. I just go to bed at my normal time.
When you have those unusually energetic days, have you used marijuana around that time?
No, I don't use marijuana at all. Never have. So that definitely wouldn't have anything to do with it.
When you have those unusually energetic days, have you been drinking alcohol around that time?
No, I don't drink. I mean, maybe a glass of wine at a wedding or something, but that's about it. So, no, alcohol isn't a factor when I get like that.
During those high-energy days, do you feel unusually confident or like you can do things better than other people?

No, not really. I don't think I'm better than anyone else or anything like that. I just feel like I can get a lot more done than usual, but I don't feel overly confident or like I'm suddenly great at everything. Just... productive, I guess.
During those high-energy days, do your thoughts race?

No, I wouldn't say they race. I mean, I'm thinking about what I need to do next, sure, but my mind doesn't feel out of control or anything. It's pretty clear, actually. I just stay focused on whatever I'm working on.
During those high-energy days, do you find yourself starting a lot more projects or getting much more done than usual?

Yes, definitely. I get a lot more done. At work, I've been taking on all these extra safety-improvement projects at the warehouse. And outside of work, I've been signing up for way more art workshops than I normally would. I even started making all these lists and schedules to keep track of everything... it's almost like I'm running a whole operation by myself.
During those high-energy days, do you find yourself talking more than usual?

Yes, I definitely do. My husband and my coworkers actually tell me I talk so fast they can't even get a word in. I'll just be going on about new recipes, or my safety ideas for the warehouse, or those art classes... and I just, I honestly feel like I have to finish every thought right then and there, before it disappears on me.
During those high-energy days, do you feel driven to stay constantly busy or keep moving from one task to another?

Yeah, I do. Usually after my shifts at the warehouse, I'm pretty worn out, but on those days... I come home buzzing. I just have to keep doing things. I'll end up reorganizing the cabinets or, you know, sorting all the bins out in the garage. Just sitting down on the couch to relax feels completely impossible.
About how many days in a row do these high-energy periods usually last?
I'm not really sure, honestly. I haven't... I haven't ever really counted the days. It just sort of goes on for a bit, but I couldn't give you an exact number.
During those high-energy periods, have they ever lasted at least 4 days in a row?

I really can't say for sure. Like I was just saying, I don't track the time when I get like that. It definitely goes on for a few days, but... whether it's exactly four days in a row, or more, or less, I just don't know. I'm sorry I can't give you a better timeline.
During those high-energy periods, do you do things that could get you into trouble, like spending too much money?

Yeah, I do. Um... I've definitely spent way more than I should sometimes. I'll go to these craft markets and just buy a whole bunch of stuff—paints, frames, different tools. At the time, I'm so sure I'm going to turn it all into these great, useful projects. But then... well, I look at the credit card bill later and I just feel really embarrassed about it.
